ideas.title: Uncovering the scope of Minnesota's fraud problem
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota, including the $9B Somali fraud case and other high-profile cases
questions: What are the root causes of Minnesota's fraud problem?
How can the state prevent future cases?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud problem in Minnesota, and I recommend using data analysis and public records to investigate further.
